headline: Jefferson go through conference play without dropping a point
dek: Jefferson's only defeat this season came against a non-conference side in September, and they have won every match since. They have scored 49 goals across all their matches and conceded eleven; Bridgeport, whom they beat in October, are the only side to have let in as few.
displaced_by: Bridgeport's home defeat to Saint Michael's took their goals against to 11, level with Jefferson's, so the standing dek's 'only Bridgeport have let in fewer' no longer held; the headline is still true and stands
